title: project-facts
summary: Report what the build does: defines that are on and what sets each, imports, output paths and packages
intro: Read this when you need to know what a build really does: which defines are on and what sets each, the imports, output paths and packages. It reads the .dproj and can flag a post-processor define that has no build step imported.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint project-facts --dproj PATH [--platform win32|win64] [--config Release|Debug] [--db PATH] [--json] (what the BUILD does: defines ON and what sets each, <Import>s, output paths, packages; flags a post-processor define with no build step imported)
help: drag-lint project-facts --dproj PATH [--platform win32|win64] [--config Release|Debug] [--db PATH] [--json]   (what the BUILD does: defines ON and what sets each, <Import>s, output paths, packages; flags a post-processor define with no build step imported)
--format sarif            emit SARIF 2.1.0 (in addition to text|json)
--fail-on <level>         exit nonzero iff a surviving finding is >= error|warning|info (or none)

--profile <name>          merge a named enable/disable set from the config; built-in: cwe, cert, misra, cwe-top25 (rules labelled under that standard, severity floor warning; a config profile of the same name wins)

--target-compiler <v>     lint / lint-all / rules / lsp: the oldest compiler the code must compile on -- 13, 12, 11, 10.4, 10.3, XE7 ..., a CompilerVersion (37, 36 ...) or auto (the .dproj ProjectVersion); modernize findings whose fix needs a newer compiler are not reported; default 37 = Delphi 13 (config key target_compiler, profile-overridable)
--baseline <file>         report only findings absent from the baseline
--write-baseline <file>   record current findings as the baseline and exit 0

questions.ask: Which defines are on and what sets each?
Where does the build write its output?
